# awscc_wellarchitected_agent_context (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::WellArchitected::AgentContext



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `agent_context_id` (String) The service-generated unique identifier of the Agent Context.
- `application_type` (String) Type of the application described by this context. Mirrors the value stored in `Content.applicationType` and is surfaced as a typed read-only attribute by the service for discoverability.
- `arn` (String) The synthetic Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Agent Context, composed of the parent profile ARN and the context id.
- `content` (String) The free-form content of the Agent Context, supplied as an arbitrary JSON object.
- `context_type` (String) The type of the Agent Context.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the context was created.
- `created_by` (String) The identifier of the system or user that created this context.
- `criticality` (String) Business criticality of the application described by this context. Mirrors the value stored in `Content.criticality` and is surfaced as a typed read-only attribute by the service for discoverability.
- `last_modified_at` (String) The timestamp when the context was last modified.
- `last_modified_by` (String) The identifier of the system or user that last modified this context.
- `profile_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the parent Agent Profile that owns this context. Pass `!Ref` of the parent AWS::WellArchitected::AgentProfile to flow its ARN here.
- `title` (String) The title of the Agent Context.
